title: The Lantern Key
description:
You come upon a faintly glowing key and go to pick it up.

"Been looking all over for that key! Now if you don't mind..."

 This person looks like bad news but maybe it's not good to be judgy.
notes: Choosing to return the key grants 100 Gold and ends the event immediately. Choosing to keep the key leads to a combat encounter with the Mysterious Knight. Victory in combat rewards the [gold]Lantern Key[/gold] card.
